name: 86 Chaos 16.0.6 Presence Snapshot and Schedule Builder Assignment Fix
label: 16.0.6 Presence Snapshot and Schedule Builder Assignment Fix
notes: Hardens the System Administrator Online / Last Seen snapshot so RTDB reads are capped, timeout-safe, and never hold the page hostage.
Falls back to a safe roster/profile presence snapshot when the backend presence source is slow or unavailable.
Fixes Schedule Builder manual assignment so selected dates are tied to one stable employee instead of carrying selections across rows.
Lets managers delete malformed or duplicate visible shift cells by matching the actual visible shift records instead of only exact employeeId fields.
